# Toggle

> A 40×40 icon button that stays on or off, alone or as one choice in a group.

| Implemented in | The accounting app (`src/rost/toggle/Toggle.tsx`, `.rost-toggle`) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | boolean |  | `false` |
| `label` | slot |  |  |
| `labelled` | boolean |  | `false` |

## States

`Default` · `Hover` · `Pressed` · `Focus` · `Disabled`

## Anatomy

- `root`
- `background`: The see-through plate when it's off, on its own layer so the icon stays solid.
- `icons-arrow-left`: The 20px icon slot. Its colour is the action's `icon` token: primary when it's on, secondary when it's off.
- `label`: Not in Figma, which has no labelled toggle. Body type, medium, with tabular numbers so years line up. Its colour follows the state, the way a button's label does.
- `glyph`: Figma's arrow, drawn as a mask in the icon's colour. A caller's own icon replaces it and should use `currentColor`.
- `focus-ring`

## When to use

- Switching a view or a filter on and off, when the change happens straight away.
- Picking one option from a short set, as a group. The year switcher in the accounting app works like this.

## When not to use

- Doing something. That's **IconButton**. A toggle remembers, a button doesn't.
- A settings-style switch with a label. There isn't one in the kit yet, so ask for one rather than stretching Toggle.

## Behaviour

It changes with `selected` and `state`. Off, it's a plate with 12px corners on the secondary surface, faded down. On, it becomes a fully round primary pill. The change of shape is part of the signal, not just the colour.

## Accessibility

- **Alone**: `<button aria-pressed="true|false">`.
- **Group**: `role="radio"` with `aria-checked`, inside a `role="radiogroup"` that has a name. Arrow keys move between options, Tab gets you in and out.
- **Tabs**: `role="tab"` with `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`, inside a `role="tablist"` that has a name. Only the selected tab is in the tab order; arrow keys, Home and End move between them. rost.build's Preview and Code tabs work this way.
- **Name**: `aria-label` when it's icon only.
- **Focus**: `focus-ring` (2px, `actions/primary/focus/focus-ring` when it's on), on `:focus-visible`.
- **Colour**: on and off show in the shape (12px corners to fully round) as well as the colour.

## Content

An icon, or a short text label: a year, a number, one word. The label makes the toggle grow wider than 40px, and it never wraps. Figma only draws the icon-only one.

## Where code differs on purpose

| App | What | Why | Taken to design |
|---|---|---|---|
| The accounting app | Each toggle is a `role="radio"` inside a `ToggleGroup`. The group has no surface of its own. | There they're one choice from a set. The kit has no ToggleGroup, so the accounting app made one. | not yet |

## No token, on purpose

| Part | Property | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glyph` | `mask` | `url(./icon-arrow-left.svg) center / contain no-repeat` | The icon file itself, `assets/icons/arrow-left.svg`, the same shape as Figma's `Union` layer. |
| `focus-ring` | `inset` | `calc(-1 * var(--spacing-gap-2xsmall))` | Composed from a token: the ring sits spacing/gap/2xsmall outside the element. |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--actions-primary-default-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--actions-primary-hover-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
